verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents receiving packages and holding them for a limited time (up to 10 days), plus forwarding physical items, including international and expedited shipments for a fee. That covers holding and forwarding in a basic way, but nothing confirms which carriers it accepts or that it offers consolidation or in-person pickup. Missing for 10: evidence of acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, local pickup option, longer package hold periods, independent corroboration.
